extra.exh_temp_conflict: UNRESOLVED. Two manufacturer documents of the same 8180 kWe / 10 470 kJ/kWe-hr ISO rating disagree: BPGPH/0525 (2025 handbook) 'Exhaust Gas Temp deg C 519 / deg F 967' vs DS70PG/1118 (2018 data sheet) 'Exhaust Temp. 515°C (960°F)'; each pair is self-consistent (519 C = 966 F, 515 C = 959 F). Neither has a second confirmation; energy balance does not separate them (q = 0.956 at 519 C, 0.948 at 515 C with G 26.9 kg/s, 34.4 %). 519 kept in exh_temp_C only as the newest edition; 505 C belongs to the 7965 kWe edition and is not an option.

records.notes: Editions opened (all PDF from s7d2.scene7.com unless noted): DS70PG/1118 (2018, CM20150703-52095-12880, newest GS data sheet, the one linked from the product page): 'Output Power 8180 kWe', 'Heat Rate 10 470 kJ/kWe-hr (9920 Btu/kWe-hr)', 'Exhaust Flow 95 150 kg/hr (213,125 lb/hr)' (kg and lb disagree: 213,125 lb/hr = 96 670 kg/hr), 'Exhaust Temp. 515°C (960°F)', 'Engine efficiency: 34%', PR 16.5:1, 3.7 m enclosed height, 61 775 kg. BPGPH/0525 (2025 handbook, same scene7 asset as the former 2019 edition): '8.2' MW, '10,470' kJ/kWe-hr, '9,920' Btu, 'Electrical Efficiency % 34.4', 'Exhaust Gas Flow kg/s 26.9 / lb/s 59.2', 'Exhaust Gas Temp deg C 519 / deg F 967', fuel input 23.8 MJ/s, package 11.1 x 2.8 x 3.5 m, 61,775 kg 'Dry weight, unenclosed height and weight'. BIL/0622 (2022): 'Taurus 70 8180 34.4 6900-13 800 11.1 36' 3" 2.9 9' 2" 3.7 12' 1" 61 775 136,215'. Older 7965 kWe edition: DS70GS/1111 (2011, O&G): 7965 kWe, 10 505 kJ/kWe-hr, 96 775 kg/hr (213,350 lb/hr), 510°C (945°F), 34 %, PR 17.6:1, 'Max. Speed: 15,200 rpm', package 11.9 x 2.9 x 3.7 m, 62 935 kg (radial/axial exhaust offshore-spec package); DS70PG/0413 (2013): 7965 kWe, 10 505, 96 775 kg/hr, 505°C (945°F), PR 17.6:1, 10.8 x 2.8 x 3.7 m, 62 900 kg; BO&G/811: 7965 kWe, 10 505, 96 775 kg/hr, 510°C, approx. package 11.3 x 2.8 x 2.8 m, 56 885 kg; BIL/512: 7965, 34.0 %, 11.9 x 2.9 x 3.7, 62 935 kg; BPGPSG/116: '8.0 MW', 10 505, 505°C (945°F), 96.8 thousand kg/hr, package 11.1 x 2.9 x 3.7 m, 61 775 kg; Turbomach BPHBTBM/512: 7.96 MW, 10'503 kJ/kWh, 34.27 %, 'Exhaust gas flow: kg/s 26.88', 508°C, Turbomach-built package 12.6 x 2.9 x 9.4 m incl. filter, 68 t. Manufacturer product page (solarturbines.com) NOT openable in this session: curl HTTP 403 Akamai 'Access Denied' at 18:07 and 18:19 UTC, WebFetch 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'. Its values were known only from search extracts (8180 kWe with 9955 Btu = 10 505 kJ, 213,350 lb/h, 945°F / 505 C) - this mixes the 8180 kWe power with the heat rate/flow/temperature of the 7965 kWe edition (identical to DS70PG/0413), so the earlier record was internally inconsistent; corrected to the 8180 kWe edition as printed in the opened documents. Taken: power 8180 kWe (DS70PG/1118 = BIL/0622 = BPGPH/0525). Heat rate changed 10 505 -> 10 470. eff_pct 34.4 is PUBLISHED (BPGPH/0525, BIL/0622); 3600/10470 = 34.38 agrees (DS70PG/1118 rounds to 34 %). Exhaust flow changed 26.88 -> 26.9 kg/s: BPGPH/0525 prints 26.9 kg/s (59.2 lb/s = 26.85 kg/s) and DS70PG/1118 lb/hr value 213,125 lb/hr = 26.85 kg/s agree; the DS70PG/1118 kg/hr value 95 150 (= 26.43 kg/s) disagrees with its own lb/hr and is treated as a misprint, so exh_flow_kg_h is left null; 26.88 kg/s belongs to the 7965 kWe edition. Exhaust temperature changed 505 -> 519 C (newest manufacturer publication BPGPH/0525); DS70PG/1118 prints 515°C (960°F); spread over editions 505-519 C. PR kept 16.5 (DS70PG/1118, newest sheet) - but DS70PG/0413 and DS70GS/1111 print 17.6:1 (see extra.pr_editions). out_rpm: value 15,200 kept, source moved from etn.global to Solar DS70GS/1111 ('Max. Speed: 15,200 rpm', turbine maximum; nominal 50/60 Hz turbine speed not published). Package: length 11.1 m and weight 61 775 kg confirmed by DS70PG/1118; height changed 3.5 -> 3.7 m (data sheet 'enclosed height'; the 2025 handbook's 3.5 m is unenclosed - kept in extra.pkg_H_unenclosed_m); width kept 2.8 m (see extra.pkg_W_note). No Taurus 70 generator-set Turbomachinery Package Specification found on allowed hosts (manualsdir 66910 is TPS70CSMD/309, compressor set/mechanical drive), so engine mass/size, starter kW, fuel gas pressure, lube volumes, bleed valves and engine change time remain unverified for GS; the two-shaft CS/MD engine figures (5630 kg, 56 kW starter, 1860-3477 kPag fuel, 4713 L tank) are NOT transferred to the single-shaft GS engine. siemens-energy.com and centraxgt.com not consulted (other manufacturers, no Solar documents expected). Skeptic check 14.11.2026: exh_temp_C marked UNRESOLVED (519 vs 515, extra.exh_temp_conflict); engine designation T-10801 tied to the 7965 kWe edition document. Other changes re-read in the PDFs and confirmed.

extra.fuel_gas_kPa: 1860 to 3477 kPag (270 to 500 psig) at skid edge: 'Minimum/Maximum Gas Fuel Supply Pressure 1860 to 3477 kPag (270 to 500 psig), See Note (b)' (TPS70CSMD/715; 500 psig = 3447 kPag, so the kPa figure is likely a misprint); 'Minimum Flow Rate 1950 kg/hr (4297 lbm/hr)'; 'Minimum/Maximum Fuel Supply Temperature -40° to 93°C', fuel at least 27°C above dew point. TPS70CSMD/309 (2009): '1860 to 2760 kPag (270 to 400 psig)'. Note (b): requirements are site-specific, 'minimum fuel pressure and flow requirements may be less than stated values'
extra.lube: 'Lube Oil Tank Capacity 4713 L (1245 gal)' + 'An additional 246 L (65 gal) is required for package filters and piping'; main pump 'Engine-Driven Rotary Screw', 'Flow 1440 lpm (380 gpm)', 'Discharge Pressure 607 kPag (88 psig)', supply regulated to '345-414 kPag (50-60 psig)'; pre/post 'AC Motor-Driven Rotary Screw Pump' 7.5 kW; backup 'DC Motor-Driven Rotary Gear Pump' 110 VDC 1.1 kW; tank heater 19 kW; oil ISO VG 32 (<43°C ambient) / VG 46; cooler 'Design Heat Load (Per Cooler) Project Specific', approach 22.2°C, max cooler outlet 66°C, cooler loop max 276 kPad; vent coalescer 576 kg (TPS70CSMD/715). TPS70CSMD/309: same tank and main pump, pre/post and backup pumps 'Centrifugal', backup 120 VDC. Heat rejection kW not published
extra.variable_geometry: Variable inlet guide vanes: 'Axial Compressor - 14 Stage - Variable Inlet Guide Vanes' (DS70MD/412, DS70CS/412); TPS start sequence 'The inlet guide vanes open and the bleed valve gradually closes'. Variable stators not listed for MD (the GS sheets say 'Variable Inlet Guide Vanes and Stators'); number of variable rows not published
extra.bleed_valves: Bleed valve named in singular, count not tabulated: start sequence 'the bleed valve gradually closes'; SoLoNOx 'combustion airflow is regulated using a bleed valve mounted on the combustor case' (TPS70CSMD/715 and /309)
extra.accessory_gearbox: Yes: 'The starter motor is mounted directly on the gas turbine accessory drive gearbox'; 'The main lube oil pump is mounted on an integral accessory drive gearbox'; 'Accessory Gear Housing Ductile Iron' (TPS70CSMD/715); 'Accessory Gearbox | Velocity Pickup' (TPS70CSMD/309 vibration list)
extra.bearings: TPS70CSMD/715 and /309 Table 2: 'Radial 5 Tilt Pad with Proximity Probes', 'Thrust 2 Tilt Pad with Resistance Temperature Device Probes'; TPS70CSMD/309 vibration list 'Turbine Bearing #1' to '#5' (X and Y displacement probes), GP and PT keyphasors. DS70MD/412: 'Journal and Thrust: Tilt Pad'
extra.engine_removal: Lateral: 'The engine area is furnished with bi-fold type doors to facilitate engine removal from either side of the package'; handling kit 'Internal maintenance frame trolley rails', '3048-mm (10-ft) external extensions to the maintenance frame trolley rails with support frame', 'Rail hugger chain-fall hoists and trolley'; 'The gas turbine can be removed through either enclosure side and placed on a truck bed or cart' (TPS70CSMD/715). Removal time not published
extra.inlet_exhaust_dp_note: ISO rating basis 'No Inlet/Exhaust Losses' (TPS70CSMD/715 Table 2 note (a); DS70MD/412). Package design limits in TPS70CSMD/715 (same in /309): air inlet 'Pressure Drop Less Than 102 mm (4 in.) H2O with a Clean Air Filter' (= 1.0 kPa, unit conversion); exhaust 'Total System Pressure Loss Should Not Exceed 152 mm (6 In.) of Water' (= 1.49 kPa), 'Nominal System Back Pressure 203 mm (8 in.) of water' (= 1.99 kPa), 'The exhaust backpressure should be less than 254 mm (10 in.) water column during gas turbine starting' (= 2.49 kPa)
extra.combustor: 'Combustion Chamber - Single Annular Type - Conventional or Lean-Premixed, Dry, Low Emission (SoLoNOx) - 12 Fuel Injectors - Torch Ignitor System' (DS70MD/412)
extra.compressor_case: 'Axially Split Case' (DS70MD/412) vs 'Vertically Split Case' (DS70CS/412, same year, same engine) - conflict as published
extra.temperature_control: 'Temperature control is based on the third-stage nozzle temperature (T5)'; 'T5 (12) Thermocouples' (TPS70CSMD/715)
extra.optional_gearbox: 'Gearbox 1630 kg (3600 lb)', 'Major Inspection Interval 30,000 hours', 'Overhaul Interval 100,000 hours', 'API 613 Compliant With Exceptions'; output rotation counterclockwise viewed from exhaust end (TPS70CSMD/715 section 6)
extra.heat_rate_note: 10 170 kJ/kWh is a unit conversion of the published 'Heat Rate 7187.7 Heat Rate (Btu/hr-hp)' (TPS70CSMD/715, T70-10802): 7187.7 x 1.05506 / 0.7457 = 10 170; cross-check: published efficiency 35.4 % (BIL/0622) -> 3600/0.354 = 10 169

records.notes: Editions opened: TPS70CSMD/715 (2015 Turbomachinery Package Specification, Compressor Set and Mechanical Drive, s7d2 C10660338) - newest engine/package document, taken for performance detail, PR, dimensions and systems; TPS70CSMD/309 (2009, manualsdir 66910, pages 2-34, 48-50, 59-62, 71-72 opened) - same package dimensions/weights and systems, older 7690 kW rating; BIL/0622 (2022) - current published rating 8290 kW / 11,110 hp / 35.4 %; DS70MD/412 and DS70CS/412 (2012) - 8140 kW edition; BO&G/811 (2011), BIL/512 (2012). Manufacturer product page not openable (curl 403 Akamai at 18:07 and 18:19 UTC; WebFetch 'ENOTFOUND'); its search-extract values (11,110 hp / 8290 kW, 7190 Btu/hp-hr = 10 170 kJ/kW-hr, 215,990 lb/h, 935°F) agree with BIL/0622 + TPS70CSMD/715 T70-10802 block. Power 8290 kW confirmed by BIL/0622 ('Taurus 70 8290 11,110 35.4'); TPS70CSMD/715 prints 8316 kW for the same T70-10802 rating with note '(b) Excludes Accessory Gear Box Load for Lube Oil Pump' - 8290 is taken as the net shaft rating. Heat rate 10 170 kept (unit conversion of TPS 7187.7 Btu/hp-hr, cross-checked by 35.4 %; see extra.heat_rate_note). eff_pct 35.4 PUBLISHED (BIL/0622); 3600/10170 = 35.40 agrees. Exhaust flow 97 970 kg/hr (215,987 lb/hr) confirmed by TPS70CSMD/715 -> 27.21 kg/s. Changes: exhaust temperature 500 -> 501°C (TPS70CSMD/715 '501°C (933°F)'); PR 16.5 -> 17.5 (TPS70CSMD/715 'Compression Ratio 17.5:1'; 16.5 belongs to the 2009/2012 editions); package width 2.7 -> 2.64 m, height 3.3 -> 3.27 m (unenclosed), weight 24 950 -> 24 494 kg (TPS Table 1; the data sheet's '24 950 kg (54,000 lb)' is a kg misprint, 54,000 lb = 24 494 kg); engine_kg kept null (TPS 'Gas Turbine Assembly (SoLoNOx) 5630 kg (11,260 lb)' - kg and lb disagree, 5630 = 11,260/2; UNRESOLVED 5107 vs 5630 kg, see extra.engine_kg_basis). out_rpm: PT maximum 12,000 rpm (TPS70CSMD/715, DS70MD/412); nominal/optimum PT speed and range not published. Engine length/diameter, lube heat rejection, number of variable stator rows and engine change time not published. All systems data are for the two-shaft CS/MD engine and package only. Skeptic check 14.11.2026: engine_kg reset to null (UNRESOLVED). All other MD changes re-read in TPS70CSMD/715, TPS70CSMD/309, DS70MD/412, DS70CS/412 and BIL/0622 and confirmed. Caution: PR 17.5, exhaust 501 C, starter, fuel, lube and dimension details come only from the TPS ('Caterpillar Confidential Green'); per the gtu-fleet skill such TPS-only numbers go to the repository only after the owner's decision.
